literal_meaning: টপটপ করে ঝরা বা মৃদু শব্দ সূচক দ্বিত্বশব্দ (চুঁই অর্থ ঝরা)
figurative_meaning_bn: আগুনে জ্বাল, ক্ষুধা, জলশোষণ ইত্যাদির মতো মৃদু অনুভূতি সূচক দ্বিত্বশব্দ
figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicated word indicating mild sensations such as burning from fire, hunger, thirst, etc.
example_sentences_in_english: My stomach is rumbling with hunger.
My throat is parched with thirst in the heat.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in everyday Bengali speech to describe subtle physical discomforts.
